landing.heroSubtitle: The one platform for everything your society runs — events today, with visitor management, vendor tracking, parking, and AI-powered security on the way.
landing.newMembersHint: New members: register with email — committee activates within 24 hours.
landing.platformTitle: One app for everything your society runs
landing.platformSubtitle: Events & Ticketing and Visitor Management are live today. Four more services are already on the roadmap for {{name}}.
landing.platformCta: Have an idea for your society? Let your committee know.
landing.eventsDetailSubtitle: Everything below is already live and ready to use.
landing.featuresBookPayDesc: Reserve seats instantly and pay via UPI, card or net banking. Get a QR-code ticket on confirmation.
landing.featuresQrDesc: Show your digital ticket QR code at the gate for a smooth, paperless check-in experience.
landing.featuresSecureDesc: Your data stays within the society. Secured by Keycloak SSO with role-based access control.
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: Three simple steps to get started — the same simple flow every future service will follow
landing.howStep1Desc: Sign up with your email. The committee verifies your residency and activates your account within 24 hours.
landing.howStep2Desc: Browse upcoming events filtered by category. View details, schedules, and available seats.
landing.howStep3Desc: Reserve your spot, pay online, and show your QR-code ticket at the gate. It's that simple.

forgotPasswordPage.successHint: Didn't receive it? Check your spam folder or try again in a few minutes.
forgotPasswordPage.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

home.sectionSubtitleGuard: Quick access to your gate operations.
home.sectionSubtitleAll: Events & Ticketing and Visitor Management are live today — jump straight in from each card below. Here's everything else coming to the platform.

roleWelcome.admin: You have full admin access across your society's services — starting with events, and growing.
roleWelcome.committee_member: Create and manage events, and register for them just like any resident.
roleWelcome.resident: Your society, in one place — events and tickets today, with more services on the way.
roleWelcome.security_guard: Use the QR scanner below to verify resident tickets at the gate.
roleWelcome.sponsor: Track your sponsorships, monitor event funding, and manage refund requests.
